en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Gothic/Renaissance-style tomb with rich reliefs and a recumbent armored effigy on top. The scene is indoors, in a church interior. French captions identify the subject as the tomb of Charles the Bold in the Church of Our Lady in Bruges. There is also printed branding with a star and the word "Bruges" on the wall at left and a vertical credit line at the right edge.
